_meta.purpose: Ground-truth retrodiction benchmark. Each case is a real chart with DOCUMENTED life outcomes. The engine is scored on whether its deterministic verdict matches recorded reality. Accuracy over comfort: a HEDGE on a decisive life is a logged calibration failure, never smoothed over.
_meta.birth_time_confidence: AA=birth certificate/record, A=from memory/quoted, C=rectified/disputed. Low-confidence times weaken any conclusion drawn from a MISS.
_meta.expected_polarity: POSITIVE = the native decisively achieved this; NEGATIVE = decisively did not / suffered loss here.
_meta.sources_note: Times sourced from astro-databank / widely published. Disputed times flagged. Add cases freely; never delete a MISS to inflate the score.
